capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Toyota USA 2027 C-HR release: 'total capacity of 74.7 kWh' (unchanged from 2026).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: C-HR uses the same 74.7 kWh pack as the bZ (Toyota USA C-HR release: 74.7 kWh); EV Database lists 71.0 kWh usable for the 74.7 kWh bZ4X pack. Canada quotes 77 kWh total for the C-HR (probably the same pack, not usable).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: C-HR BEV shares the bZ's 74.7 kWh pack (Toyota USA C-HR release); chief engineer: the larger bZ pack 'retains the same chemistry and cells' (NMC).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Shares the bZ's 74.7 kWh pack, 391 V nominal per Autopian; the bZ is a 400 V architecture (InsideEVs).

preconditioning.notes: Toyota USA: preconditioning can be turned on manually in system settings or automatically when a fast-charging station is the navigation destination (automatic needs Drive Connect).

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs states the C-HR charges at a 150 kW maximum (Toyota figure); same as the 2026 C-HR powertrain record. Toyota's 2027 release says the car is unchanged.

ac_max_kw.notes: Toyota USA 2027 C-HR release: 11 kW on-board charger.

published_10_80_min.notes: Toyota USA: about 30 minutes 10-80% under ideal conditions.
